note: Twenty-three pages, 37 measured regions: 23 page-foot WeChat stamps - one on every page at the identical [448.9,767.2,592.2,838.8] block, 693 paths, 0.020 area, never fused with anything - and 14 exhibits, which are Figures 1 to 13 plus one symbol table. No region in this paper is display maths: every equation here is set as text, so unlike #269 and #270 the exclusion list holds nothing but the page stamps and the census is a clean 1:1 on the exhibit side. The exhibit side is nevertheless a trap of another kind: seven of the thirteen figures are tables captured as raster images (Figures 2, 3, 8, 10, 11, 12, 13), so the caption word 'Figure' describes a ruled grid seven times out of thirteen and the family must be read from the crop. Numbering is the cleanest in this block - colon form, 1 to 13, no gap and no repeat - and captions are uniform: all thirteen below their raster at 15.34 to 15.35 pt, a band 0.01 pt wide and the tightest recorded in this lane. The one real table is the p6 symbol list, 22 rows by 2 columns, booktabs from exactly 3 paths, with NO printed caption at all: its only title is the section heading '3 Symbol Table' standing 26.4 pt above it. Citation is the thinnest in the block so far - two counted pointers, Figure 1 on p7 and the ligature spelling 'as shown in figure5.' on p13, both on their own pages, and twelve of the fourteen exhibits never named - with four bare gestures counted for nothing because they name no exhibit noun or stand on a two-exhibit page. Families: 7 table-as-figure, 2 bar (Figures 4 and 7, both stacked), 2 other (Figures 5 and 9, radars the vocabulary does not name) and 2 flowchart-or-schematic (Figure 1's four-level tree, Figure 6's chevron timeline).
rules: Seven of the thirteen exhibits captioned as figures are TABLES, not drawings: Figures 2 and 3 on p9, Figure 8 on p16 and Figures 10 to 13 on p22 and p23 all print as ruled grids of cells, so [geometry.family] is 'table-as-figure' on those seven rows and only six figure rows are actual graphics. This is the first paper in this lane whose caption word and content type disagree at that rate, and it is why family counts are recorded from the crop and never from the caption.

The one genuine table is the p6 symbol list: 22 rows by 2 columns, measured from exactly 3 vector paths, so [table.rule_style] is 'booktabs' - top rule, header rule, bottom rule - with no interior rule and no vertical rule anywhere. The bottom rule was confirmed on a cropped proxy because the header rule and the top rule are the two that read first at page scale.

The p6 table prints no caption line at all. Its only title is the section heading '3 Symbol Table' whose box ends 9.3 pt above the grid, so that row is recorded with [caption.words] 0, an empty verbatim and caption_source 'none' instead of promoting a heading into a caption the paper never prints.

Caption side is uniform and kind-driven with no exception: all thirteen figure captions print BELOW their raster, and the thirteen gaps span 0.01 pt - 15.34 to 15.35 pt, the tightest caption band recorded in this lane against #270's 1.2 to 25.6 pt spread - so [caption.position] is 'below' on every figure row and 'above' only on the uncaptioned p6 table, where the nearest printed text is the heading.

Every caption uses the colon form 'Figure N:' and the numbers run 1 to 13 without a gap or a repeat, so [caption.numbering] is 'Figure N:' on all thirteen rows - the first clean numbering run in this block after #269's doubled labels and #270's period style printed four times over.

Citation is nearly absent: exactly TWO counted pointers in twenty-three pages, Figure 1 on p7 (printed on its own page, so lead_pages 0) and Figure 5 on p13 (also lead_pages 0). [mention.count] is therefore 1 on two rows and 0 on the other twelve, and twelve exhibits are never cited at all - Figures 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13 and the symbol table.

Bare pointers are counted only when they name an exhibit noun AND their page holds exactly one exhibit, and this paper fails both tests wherever it gestures: p15's 'As shown in the figure' names a figure but stands on a page with two of them, while p12's 'The results are as follows:', p18's 'is as follows:' and p9's 'as shown below.' name no exhibit noun at all, so all four are counted for nothing rather than guessed onto a row, and [mention.count] stays 0 on every row they stand near.

The two radar charts - Figure 5 on p13 and Figure 9 on p18 - are 'other' with an other_note, because the closed fourteen-family vocabulary has no radar or spider member. [geometry.printed_numbers] is true on both (the ticks 5, 10 and 15 print along the top spoke) but [geometry.data_labels] is false on both, since no vertex carries a value.

Legends split three ways and are recorded from the crop: [geometry.legend] is 'inside' on Figure 4 (key strip within the axes frame) and Figure 5 (key box on the plotting area), 'above' on Figure 7, 'outside-left' on Figure 9, and 'none' on all seven table-as-figure rows, on both flowcharts and on Figure 1. Nothing in this paper is 3D and nothing carries a colourbar, so [geometry.three_d] is 'no' and [geometry.colorbar] false on every row.

[geometry.panel_count] is 1 on every row and [geometry.panel_layout] '1': each exhibit is one raster region with one drawing inside it, including Figure 8's single bare data row and the four appendix grids. No exhibit in this paper is a composite panel.

Printed defects are recorded per row and the worst are content-level, not typographic: India's bar in Figure 4 carries only three of five segments, Figure 7 prints white value labels on pale yellow, Figures 12 and 13 hold EXP and GEI constant across twenty years, Figures 10 and 11 highlight two DIFFERENT rows of one before/after pair with no legend, Figure 1 duplicates the 'UNI' node, and the p6 table mixes typeset maths with upright symbol names in one column. The paper's pink watermark prints over the grids of Figures 2 and 3 and over the p6 symbol table; [geometry.data_labels] is true on exactly the two stacked-bar rows (Figures 4 and 7), which is also where the illegible and the missing value labels sit.
